about: Registry of official basketball-court sources for hoop_pipeline.truth. Each entry: api (arcgis | socrata | file | overture_local), select (client-side filter), fields (mapping), precision (court_polygon | court_point | feature_point | park_point), coverage (polygons the source is complete for), license (verified text). See README 'Official court truth set'.
